speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Migraine with aura secondary to heart failure (cardiac migraine). The shimmering arc visual disturbance is classic for migraine aura, and while your heart failure requires management, the headache and visual symptoms are likely neurologically mediated rather than a direct complication of the heart failure itself. I recommend starting a migraine-specific treatment and optimizing your heart failure regimen.
